close_reason: Restart recovery works end to end, demonstrated live in bedrock_ex (tmux/iex): write, halt, restart on the same data dir -> epoch-2 recovery completes ~840ms reusing surviving materializers -> read returns the correct value; a third incarnation reads keys from both prior epochs. Seven distinct defects fixed across two commits (e6a5df62, e718ebf4): dead 3-tuple/legacy-key materializer discovery; catch-up polling KCV-clamped durable_version instead of applied current_version; unlock at the regressed durable floor instead of the recovery version; missing shard_materializers on the existing path; stale director service snapshot (fetch_service_directory refresh per attempt); locking filtered to old-TSL logs only (materializers never locked); recovery_attempt.logs never seeded on the existing path (generational vacancies now seeded in planning); shard-layout reader/writer format mismatch; resolvers never seeded on the existing path. Most-advanced-durable-wins when strays contend for a shard. Full-recovery regression test now asserts COMPLETED existing-cluster recovery.
description: Demonstrated via tmux/iex restart cycle in bedrock_ex: write, halt, restart -> recovery wedges in MaterializerBootstrapPhase and reads hang forever. Three defects: (1) find_materializer_service matches {kind, ref, shard_id} 3-tuples but available_services holds {kind, ref} 2-tuples — structurally dead code, so EVERY recovery creates a fresh empty system materializer; on restart the epoch-1 materializers (which restart fine under the foreman, with durable state incl. the shard layout at 19.4M in the repro) are orphaned and the empty stranger can't answer the layout query. (2) wait_for_materializer_catchup polls :durable_version, which the qzr.4 KCV clamp holds ~5s of version-time behind applied — must poll the applied (current) version, and target the layout-query read version (vector last), not the durable floor. (3) unlock passes durable_version (0 after restart — floor deliberately not persisted) where qzr.4 unlock semantics expect the recovery/rollback version; rolling a populated materializer back to 0 empties its version list. Also: handle_existing_cluster never populates shard_materializers — user shards absent from the recovered TSL. Fix: discovery via materializer_recovery_info_by_id (LockingPhase already locks materializers and collects recovery_info — add :shard_id fact), unlock with vector-last, catch up on new :current_version fact, build shard_materializers by reusing existing-by-shard and creating only the missing.
title: Restart recovery reuses existing materializers; bootstrap catch-up polls applied position
